description: arXiv:2609.21423v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Online agent deployments produce abundant execution traces, while task-specific verification and expert annotation are costly to scale. This gap raises a question: without post-execution rewards or correctness labels, what useful experience can we extract from the trajectories themselves? To efficiently use this information, we introduce DENSE...
